Leidos is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to support the Maru Program and its Intelligence Community customer. The role develops secure, scalable applications and data platforms, including back-end services, web applications, data pipelines, and cloud-native capabilities for mission-critical workflows.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, services, and data platforms supporting mission-critical workflows
Develop back-end services and RESTful APIs using Python, Java, or similar programming languages
Build modern web applications and interactive dashboards using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and contemporary front-end technologies
Develop and optimize relational database solutions using PostgreSQL/Aurora, SQL, and modern data modeling practices
Design and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and analytical processing pipelines
Integrate applications and data services with AWS cloud infrastructure, object storage, and enterprise platforms
Develop, containerize, and deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices
Troubleshoot complex application, database, integration, and infrastructure issues
Implement automated testing, secure coding practices, and performance improvements
Collaborate with architects, Product Owners, and engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions
Participate in Agile development activities, technical design discussions, and peer code reviews
For senior-level candidates, provide technical leadership, architectural guidance, mentoring, and oversight of complex engineering initiatives
